title: 第7章 开庭第8章 又拉了一坨大的
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
永元律所，黄轩拿到了法院的诉讼文书，不屑的笑了笑。
“起诉的还是故意伤害罪，老一套，真是不长记性啊。”
黄轩又指了指赔偿：
“算上所有医疗费，和赔偿费用，精神损失费等等一系列费用，他们要求赔偿100万。”
“这就更加搞笑了。”
“不过诉状里面加了一个抢劫罪，难道他们又找到了什么新的证据？”
黄轩习惯性的思考到。
而田英光的老爹，田中仁此刻也在这，他只听见了一百万的赔偿，直接一拍桌子怒道：“放屁！要我赔他们100万！穷逼做什么美梦呢！我赔他个蛋！”
生完气后，他才问道：
“黄律师，又有新证据？”
“嗯，如果他们真的拿到了抢劫罪的证据，那么能够胜诉。”这时候黄坚成补充道。
此时，田英光也在现场。
“儿子，这是不是真的？你说实话！不要隱瞒！”
“没...没有啊，我怎么可能会去抢劫！我又不是傻子！”田英光反驳道。
是的，他自己並不认为王乐乐交给他的保护费是抢劫。
那是別人交给他的，怎么能叫抢呢？
黄坚成露出了一个有些奸诈的表情说道：“不一定，有些既然他们敢提，或许真的有一些证据，我们要做好准备。”
他知道就林默那水平，百分百拿不出新证据，估计是唬人的。
他也只是想要下一下田中仁加律师委託费罢了。
谁会嫌钱少呢？

田中仁听闻，立马就紧张了起来。
“黄律，那就拜託你们查清楚了！我的委託方增加到5万！我儿子不能出任何差错，他可是要去上大学，以后当官的！”
黄坚成这才笑了：“放心吧，包在我们身上了。”
田氏父子离开了。
这时候黄轩的嘴角也微微翘起：“这种无趣稳贏的案子，也能赚五万？”
黄坚成笑著说道：“別觉得无聊，要时刻保持警惕，即使对手是林默这种弱鸡，万一他真的拿出证据来了呢？到时候就真像罗大翔说的那样，林默出奇制胜了。”
黄轩爆笑了起来：
“出奇制胜？哈哈哈哈！”
黄坚成也是一脸绷不住的表情，两人都知道，林默不过是跳樑小丑罢了。
“估计这个抢劫罪也是胡乱添加的，就像考生做卷子一样，不会也要填满。”黄坚成讽刺道。
两人又大笑了起来。
此刻的黄轩非常的自信和囂张，既然接了，热度又这么大，那就正好提一提自己的名气。
於是他直接申请了直播庭审。
因为这一期校园霸凌案件的热度很高，很快引起了受理法院江海高级法院的重视，同意直播庭审。
content_en:
At Yongyuan Law Firm, Huang Xuan received the court's litigation documents and smiled disdainfully.
"The prosecution is still for intentional injury. It's the same old thing. It really doesn't last long."
Huang Xuan pointed at the compensation again:
"Taking into account all medical expenses, compensation expenses, mental damages and other expenses, they demanded compensation of 1 million."
"That's even funnier."
"But the charge of robbery was added to the complaint. Did they find any new evidence?"
Huang Xuan thought habitually.
And Tian Yingguang's father, Tian Zhongren, was also here at the moment. He only heard the compensation of one million, and he slammed the table and said angrily: "Fart! You want me to compensate them 1 million! What kind of dream do you have for a poor man! I will pay for it!"
After getting angry, he asked:
"Lawyer Huang, is there any new evidence?"
"Well, if they really get the evidence of robbery, they can win the case." Huang Jiancheng added at this time.
At this time, Tian Yingguang was also present.
"Son, is this true? Tell the truth! Don't hide it!"
"No...no, how could I possibly rob? I'm not a fool!" Tian Yingguang retorted.
Yes, he himself did not think that the protection money Wang Lele gave him was robbery.
It was given to him by someone else, how could it be called robbery?
Huang Jiancheng showed a somewhat treacherous expression and said: "Not necessarily. Since they dare to mention it, there may be some evidence. We must be prepared."
He knew that at Lin Mo's level, he was 100% unable to produce new evidence, so he was probably bluffing.
He just wanted to pay Tanaka Renga’s legal fees.
Who would complain about the lack of money?
When Tanaka Ren heard this, he immediately became nervous.
"Huang Lu, please find out! My client has been increased to 50,000! My son can't make any mistakes. He is going to university and will become an official in the future!"
Huang Jiancheng then smiled: "Don't worry, it's all on us."
Tian and his son left.
At this time, the corners of Huang Xuan's mouth also raised slightly: "Can such a boring and sure-win case also earn 50,000?"
Huang Jiancheng said with a smile: "Don't be bored, always be vigilant. Even if the opponent is a weakling like Lin Mo, what if he really comes up with evidence? Then it will be like what Luo Daxiang said, Lin Mo won by surprise."
Huang Xuan burst into laughter:
"Victory by surprise? Hahahaha!"
Huang Jiancheng also had a nervous expression on his face. Both of them knew that Lin Mo was just a clown.
"I guess this crime of robbery was added indiscriminately, just like a candidate writing a paper. He has to fill it in if he doesn't know how to do it." Huang Jiancheng said sarcastically.
The two laughed again.
At this moment, Huang Xuan was very confident and arrogant. Since he accepted the offer and it was so popular, it was just a good time to mention his fame.
So he directly applied for a live broadcast of the trial.
Because of the high popularity of this school bullying case, it quickly attracted the attention of the Jianghai High Court, the court that accepted the case, and agreed to broadcast the trial live.
